task.instruction: Score the teamwork plugin at the head of the pull request, and at main, by the 18-line binary list fixed in the first DECIDED: comment of the task; yes 2, ambiguous 1, no 0.

world.scope: the teamwork/ folder at one commit, with the transcripts of #432, #425 and #424 for lines 14 to 16
world.deliverable: a score out of 36 per judge run, compared between head and main

task.evidence_goal: the grade shows whether the teamwork plugin is rebuilt as one /kick-off skill with the roles, names and rules the owner set

tiers.name: every question of the source rubric

criteria.text: The teamwork plugin has one skill, /kick-off, and no /handoff skill.
variants_ok: The teamwork plugin has a skills/kick-off/ folder, and skills/ holds no handoff folder.
near_miss: The plugin keeps /kick-off and a /handoff alias that only points to it.

criteria.text: The teamwork plugin has a /kick-off skill.
variants_ok: The plugin keeps /kick-off and a /handoff alias that only points to it.
near_miss: The plugin has no /kick-off skill; its skills are /lead and /handoff.

criteria.text: The kick-off skill has one whole playbook per role in references/, no subagent definition and no partial playbook.
variants_ok: references/ holds manager.md and worker.md, each whole; no file under agents/.
near_miss: references/ holds manager.md and worker.md, and the plugin keeps a judge subagent in agents/.

criteria.text: The kick-off skill has a playbook for each role in references/.
variants_ok: references/ holds manager.md and worker.md, and the plugin keeps a judge subagent in agents/.
near_miss: The kick-off skill has one playbook for all roles.

criteria.text: The word lead names no role in the teamwork plugin; manager does.
variants_ok: grep -ri 'lead' teamwork finds no role word; manager.md, a manager session name and the monitor text say manager.
near_miss: Playbooks say manager but one hook script still prints team-lead.

criteria.text: The playbooks call the manager role manager.
variants_ok: Playbooks say manager but one hook script still prints team-lead.
near_miss: Every file calls the role lead.

criteria.text: No teamwork file or session name contains MUMU, and a role is found by a plainly named means.
variants_ok: No MUMU variable remains; a script reads the session name <project>-manager to find the role.
near_miss: The MUMU variables are gone from scripts but remain in two playbook sentences.

criteria.text: No teamwork script reads a MUMU variable.
variants_ok: The MUMU variables are gone from scripts but remain in two playbook sentences.
near_miss: A script reads MUMU_ROLE to find the role.

criteria.text: The skill description says /kick-off runs only when a session is made manager or started as a worker by a manager.
variants_ok: Use when a session is made its project's manager, by the owner or by another session, or is started as a worker by its manager.
near_miss: The description says Use when starting work on a project, with no role condition.

criteria.text: The skill description starts with Use when.
variants_ok: The description says Use when starting work on a project, with no role condition.
near_miss: The description says nothing about when to run it.

criteria.text: The judge and other subagents get the file paths they need injected, never running /kick-off.
variants_ok: The judge's brief names the files it reads, and the description says Not for the judge or another subagent.
near_miss: The judge's brief names files but the skill does not forbid a subagent from running /kick-off.

criteria.text: The judge's brief names the files it reads.
variants_ok: The judge's brief names files but the skill does not forbid a subagent from running /kick-off.
near_miss: The judge is told to run /kick-off to learn its role.

criteria.text: The kick-off skill follows AGENTS.md's skill-writing rules: a Use when description, SKILL.md as a routing table, named instructions, scripts that print prose.
variants_ok: SKILL.md has a Use when description, a routing table, named rules and scripts that print prose.
near_miss: SKILL.md has a Use when description and a routing table but its instructions carry no names.

criteria.text: SKILL.md has a Use when description.
variants_ok: SKILL.md has a Use when description and a routing table but its instructions carry no names.
near_miss: SKILL.md has a long description and holds every case in the body.

criteria.text: The teamwork plugin keeps a stable control core that depends on interfaces, a domain that names no tool, policy or entity type, and herdr in the rules.
variants_ok: Core playbook steps name no herdr command; a rules file holds every herdr command.
near_miss: Core steps name herdr in two places but most herdr commands sit in the rules.

criteria.text: A rules file holds the herdr commands.
variants_ok: Core steps name herdr in two places but most herdr commands sit in the rules.
near_miss: Herdr commands appear only in playbook steps; no rules file holds any.

criteria.text: In the teamwork plugin, hooks/, monitors/ and skills/ are modular, never tightly coupled.
variants_ok: Each of hooks/, monitors/ and skills/ works alone and reaches another only through a named file or command.
near_miss: Two parts work alone but a hook imports a skill's script.

criteria.text: At least one of hooks/, monitors/ and skills/ works alone.
variants_ok: Two parts work alone but a hook imports a skill's script.
near_miss: No part works alone: each imports from the others.

criteria.text: The teamwork plugin has no agents/ folder, scripts beside their users, and bin/ only where PATH is the only way.
variants_ok: No agents/ folder; each script sits in its skill, hook or monitor folder; bin/ holds only PATH commands.
near_miss: No agents/ folder, but one script sits in a root scripts/ folder.

criteria.text: The teamwork plugin has no agents/ folder.
variants_ok: No agents/ folder, but one script sits in a root scripts/ folder.
near_miss: An agents/ folder and a root scripts/ folder both exist.

criteria.text: No deterministic constraint script remains in the teamwork plugin.
variants_ok: No script only blocks or denies a command: the deny guards are gone.
near_miss: One guard script remains that only denies a command.

criteria.text: At most one script in the teamwork plugin only denies a command.
variants_ok: One guard script remains that only denies a command.
near_miss: Several guard scripts still deny commands.

criteria.text: The teamwork rules say one herdr workspace is one team, with one manager and N workers.
variants_ok: Rules say: one herdr workspace is one team, one manager and N workers.
near_miss: Rules say a workspace holds a manager and workers and say nothing of one team.

criteria.text: The rules say one herdr workspace holds a manager and workers.
variants_ok: Rules say a workspace holds a manager and workers and say nothing of one team.
near_miss: Rules say a workspace holds one session per task.

criteria.text: The teamwork rules say one herdr tab with its first pane is one agent, with equal tab, pane, agent names.
variants_ok: Rules say: a tab and its first pane are one agent, with equal names; extra panes may be added.
near_miss: Rules say a tab is an agent and say nothing of equal names.

criteria.text: The rules say one herdr tab is one agent.
variants_ok: Rules say a tab is an agent and say nothing of equal names.
near_miss: The rules say a herdr tab holds several agents.

criteria.text: Replaying #432, with its gates and transcript, each step it needed is covered by a playbook.
variants_ok: Every step of the #432 transcript maps to a line of a playbook.
near_miss: Most steps of the #432 transcript map to a playbook line; one step maps to none.

criteria.text: More than half of the steps of the #432 transcript map to a playbook line.
variants_ok: Most steps of the #432 transcript map to a playbook line; one step maps to none.
near_miss: Fewer than half of the steps of #432 map to a playbook line.

criteria.text: Replaying #425, with its gates and transcript, each step it needed is covered by a playbook.
variants_ok: Every step of the #425 transcript maps to a line of a playbook.
near_miss: Most steps of the #425 transcript map to a playbook line; one step maps to none.

criteria.text: More than half of the steps of the #425 transcript map to a playbook line.
variants_ok: Most steps of the #425 transcript map to a playbook line; one step maps to none.
near_miss: Fewer than half of the steps of #425 map to a playbook line.

criteria.text: Replaying #424, with its gates and transcript, each step it needed is covered by a playbook.
variants_ok: Every step of the #424 transcript maps to a line of a playbook.
near_miss: Most steps of the #424 transcript map to a playbook line; one step maps to none.

criteria.text: More than half of the steps of the #424 transcript map to a playbook line.
variants_ok: Most steps of the #424 transcript map to a playbook line; one step maps to none.
near_miss: Fewer than half of the steps of #424 map to a playbook line.

criteria.text: The teamwork plugin defines fewer terms than main's kickoff Domain table.
variants_ok: Main's Domain table defines 31 terms; the head's defines 22.
near_miss: The head defines 31 terms, as many as main.

criteria.text: The teamwork plugin defines no more terms than main's kickoff Domain table.
variants_ok: The head defines 31 terms, as many as main.
near_miss: The head defines 38 terms.

criteria.text: Work still lands only as a merged pull request the judge approved, or as an approved report.
variants_ok: Rules say: a change lands by a pull request merged after the judge approves its head sha; a report lands once approved.
near_miss: Rules say a change lands by a pull request and do not say who must approve it.

criteria.text: The rules say a change lands by a pull request.
variants_ok: Rules say a change lands by a pull request and do not say who must approve it.
near_miss: Rules let the worker merge its own pull request unreviewed.
